versions.short: The bill would set a lifetime cap on the amount of tuition and fee payments that veterans can receive from the Post-9/11 GI Bill for flight training and certain contracted education programs at public colleges and universities. For veterans who first start one of these programs in the academic year beginning August 1, 2026, the cap would be $119,684, and in later years it would rise by the most recent percentage increase set under federal law. The cap would apply no matter how many of these programs a veteran takes, and it would be reduced by any GI Bill benefits already used before enrolling. The rules would apply to academic years beginning on or after August 1, 2026.
